A '''t'nal''' was a type of [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] that could be found in [[Cave/Legends|caves]] in remote locations on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the planet,<ref name="UAA" /> used "T'nal" as a first name for some members of the [[Gender/Legends|female]] sex.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The t'nal gemstones were first mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]. They were only described in a table of Sullustan female names.<ref name="GCG" />
